known_issues: Deployed draft (Version 8) builds successfully but fails to start; shows "Something went wrong" at n-1ns-draft.caffeine.xyz, indicating an internal runtime error.

existing_features.title: Fix the startup failure that shows the "Something went wrong" startup screen by ensuring actor initialization cannot throw unhandled errors during app boot (including the access-control initialization call). If initialization fails, surface the actual error to the UI layer (and console) rather than leaving the app stuck in a generic startup failure state.
Improve the StartupErrorScreen flow so the Retry action fully retries startup by re-initializing both the backend actor and the profile query (not only refetching the profile).
Change any startup/loading user-facing text that is currently in French (e.g., "Chargement...") to English.

Add minimal startup diagnostics to help identify future boot failures: when the startup error screen is shown, include a compact, user-safe error summary (no secrets/tokens), and always log the full error to the browser console.

projectName: Fix deployed draft startup crash and make retry reinitialize actor/profile
